textile_test_report_md:0:8b63dd7af779e1e.text:
Test Report TR-0398

Sample: knitted T-shirt, style 107-208, colour navy.

textile_test_report_md:1:22a434f27541f02.text:
Summary

The sample meets the dimensional stability requirement.
It does not meet the colour fastness to laundering requirement (grade 3 vs. required 4).
Bursting strength was 412 kPa, i.e. above the 350 kPa minimum.

textile_test_report_md:2:7227740ceed27c4.text: | Dimensional stability         | AATCC 135        | -3.1% length | max. -5%      | Pass        |
| Colour fastness to laundering | ISO 105-C06:2010 | Grade 3      | Grade 4       | Fail        |
| Bursting strength             | ASTM D3786       | 412 kPa      | 350 kPa min.  | Pass        |

textile_test_report_md:3:b8405be6912c6ba.text:
Recommendations

Re-dye with a reactive dye recipe and re-test to ISO 105-C06.

Construction

Fabric structure: single jersey, 1x1 lycra plated.
The fabric is knitted on a 30" dia. machine at 28 gauge; the stitch length is approx. 2.85 mm.
Lycra is fed on every feeder (i.e. full plating), not alternate feeders.

textile_spec_sheet_md:3:c819bf24496753e2.text:

Drying, then compacting to finished width.
Remarks: Req. finished GSM 180 ± 5; finished width 68".
